title: Friday OTT Releases: Cocktail 2, Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata and The Traitors 2 Lead Independence Day Weekend Lineup
text:
NEW DELHI, August 13, 2026
Friday OTT Releases are bringing a packed selection of films, period dramas, reality shows and thrillers to streaming platforms over the Independence Day weekend. Netflix, Prime Video, ZEE5, Lionsgate Play and JioHotstar have lined up new titles for viewers planning to spend the holiday at home.
The digital lineup includes Shahid Kapoor’s romantic drama Cocktail 2 , Kangana Ranaut’s Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata , Sanjay Dutt’s political drama Aakhri Sawaal , the second season of The Traitors India and Netflix’s literary adaptation My Brilliant Career .
Meanwhile, Sunny Deol’s Partition-era drama Batwara 1947 —referred to as Partition 1947 in some promotional material—is scheduled to arrive in theaters on August 14. Viewers who prefer streaming, however, will have several genres to choose from at home.
Friday OTT Releases at a Glance Title Streaming platform Release date Genre Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata ZEE5 August 14 Historical thriller-drama Aakhri Sawaal Lionsgate Play August 14 Political drama Cocktail 2 Netflix August 14 Romantic comedy-drama Aroopi Prime Video August 14 Malayalam horror thriller The Traitors India Season 2 Prime Video August 13 Reality competition My Brilliant Career Netflix August 13 Period drama Bigg Boss: The Common Man JioHotstar August 16 Reality pre-show Streaming availability may vary by country, language and subscription plan.
Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata — ZEE5 Kangana Ranaut’s Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata will make its digital debut on ZEE5 on August 14. The film, which arrived in theaters in June, is set against the background of the 26/11 Mumbai attacks.
Ranaut portrays the fictional character Geeta Madhav Gandhare, inspired by medical workers who displayed courage while protecting patients during the attack. The drama presents its story through the experiences of people caught inside a medical facility during a national crisis.
Its Independence Day weekend premiere gives audiences an opportunity to watch the film at home after its theatrical run. ZEE5 uses the stylized spelling Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata , distinguishing the 2026 film from similarly titled earlier productions. Watch on ZEE5
Release date: August 14, 2026 Platform: ZEE5 Cast highlight: Kangana Ranaut
Aakhri Sawaal — Lionsgate Play Sanjay Dutt’s Aakhri Sawaal is set to begin streaming on Lionsgate Play on August 14 following its May theatrical release.
Directed by Abhijeet Mohan Warang, the political drama stars Sanjay Dutt and Namashi Chakraborty in prominent roles. Amit Sadh and Sameera Reddy are also part of the cast.
The story explores questions connected with ideology, history and national identity. A student’s challenge to his mentor develops into a broader conflict that drives the film’s political and dramatic narrative.
Release date: August 14, 2026 Platform: Lionsgate Play Cast: Sanjay Dutt, Namashi Chakraborty, Amit Sadh and Sameera Reddy
Cocktail 2 — Netflix One of the weekend’s biggest streaming premieres is Cocktail 2 , starring Shahid Kapoor, Kriti Sanon and Rashmika Mandanna. The film will stream on Netflix beginning August 14 after opening in theaters on June 19.
Directed by Homi Adajania, the romantic comedy-drama centers on three people whose friendships and relationships become increasingly complicated. The film serves as a spiritual successor to the 2012 release Cocktail , although it introduces new characters and a separate story.
Shahid plays Kunal, while Kriti and Rashmika portray Ally and Diya. The combination of a prominent cast, romantic conflict and a holiday-weekend release could make it one of the most closely watched OTT arrivals of the week.
Release date: August 14, 2026 Platform: Netflix Cast: Shahid Kapoor, Kriti Sanon and Rashmika Mandanna Director: Homi Adajania
Aroopi — Prime Video Viewers seeking a supernatural thriller can consider the Malayalam film Aroopi . The film is expected to become available on Prime Video on August 14, with multilingual viewing options reported for Hindi, Malayalam and Tamil audiences.
Directed by Abhilash Warrier, the movie uses elements of horror, mystery and the supernatural. Its darker tone offers an alternative to the weekend’s romantic dramas and reality programs.
Because regional availability and dubbed-language options may differ, viewers should confirm the title’s listing in their local Prime Video application.
Release date: August 14, 2026 Platform: Prime Video Genre: Malayalam supernatural horror thriller
The Traitors India Season 2 — Prime Video Karan Johar returns as host of The Traitors India Season 2 , which begins streaming on Prime Video on August 13.
The reality competition brings together 21 celebrity contestants for a game built around secrecy, deception and strategic alliances. The new lineup includes Mallika Sherawat, Rhea Chakraborty, Munawar Faruqui and Krystle D’Souza.
A small group of contestants secretly plays as “traitors,” while the remaining participants attempt to identify and eliminate them. The contestants must also complete challenges and protect the prize while navigating suspicion within the group.
Release date: August 13, 2026 Platform: Prime Video Host: Karan Johar Genre: Reality competition
My Brilliant Career — Netflix Netflix’s My Brilliant Career is a six-part adaptation of Miles Franklin’s celebrated Australian novel. The period drama arrives on August 13 and stars Philippa Northeast as Sybylla Melvyn.
Sybylla is an independent young woman determined to become a writer at a time when her family and society expect her to secure her future through marriage. When she enters a wealthier social environment and meets Harry Beecham, her personal ambitions face new emotional and social pressures.
Christopher Chung plays Harry, while Genevieve O’Reilly, Anna Chancellor, Kate Mulvany and Jake Dunn appear in supporting roles.
The series combines romance with Sybylla’s fight for independence, education and creative freedom. Netflix’s official series guide
Release date: August 13, 2026 Platform: Netflix Cast: Philippa Northeast, Christopher Chung and Genevieve O’Reilly
Bigg Boss: The Common Man — JioHotstar Bigg Boss: The Common Man will premiere on JioHotstar and Vijay Television on August 16. The Tamil reality program is a digital pre-show designed to select non-celebrity participants for the upcoming milestone season of Bigg Boss Tamil .
Maya S. Krishnan hosts the selection program, with former contestants Aari, Raaju and Oviya serving as judges. Successful participants will compete for an opportunity to enter the main Bigg Boss Tamil house.
Vijay Sethupathi is associated with the main Tamil edition, but he is not the announced host of this preliminary selection show.
Release date: August 16, 2026 Platform: JioHotstar and Vijay Television Host: Maya S. Krishnan Genre: Reality pre-show
What Should You Watch This Independence Day Weekend? Those interested in a major Hindi romantic drama can choose Cocktail 2 , while Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata offers a national-event-based story suited to the Independence Day weekend.
Aakhri Sawaal caters to viewers interested in political and ideological drama. Horror fans can consider Aroopi , while reality television audiences have two major options in The Traitors India Season 2 and Bigg Boss: The Common Man .
For viewers who prefer literary adaptations and character-driven period dramas, My Brilliant Career provides a story centered on ambition, independence and resistance to social expectations.

Release date: August 14, 2026 Cast: Shahid Kapoor, Kriti Sanon and Rashmika Mandanna Viewers seeking a supernatural thriller can consider the Malayalam film Aroopi.
